scoring_justification: Tc is recomputed from λ and ω_log using the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula (μ*=0.1); λ, ω_log, N(E_F) are compared to paper Table III; Spearman correlation and pressure/doping ordering are structural but derived from the agent's reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference λ, ω_log, N(E_F) for RS-LuH and Lu4NH3 at 0,1,10 GPa
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table III of J. Appl. Phys. 136, 023903 (2024)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied verbatim from the published table
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported numbers in the paper; they constitute the hidden gold for direct comparison.

outputs.description: Table of computed superconducting parameters for all studied compounds and pressures. The hidden checker compares the Tc, λ, ω_log, and N(E_F) values to paper-reported reference numbers and validates the monotonic increase of Tc with lanthanide atomic number (excluding Yb and La anomalies), the decrease of Tc with increasing pressure for RS-LuH and Lu4NH3, and the lower Tc of the N-doped compound compared to pristine RS-LuH at each pressure.

output_contract.notes: All required compounds and pressures are listed in the step action. For YbH at 0 GPa (dynamically unstable) the Tc field may be left blank or omitted; the checker handles this when evaluating trends.

steps.description: Verify CSV exists, has required columns, and contains at least 21 rows.
Recompute Tc from λ and ω_log using McMillan-Allen-Dynes (μ*=0.1) and compare with reported Tc; score average agreement.
Compare λ, ω_log, N(E_F) for the six known rows to Table III gold with ±10% relative tolerance.
Spearman rank correlation of Tc vs atomic number for lanthanide series at 0 GPa (excluding La and Yb) must be ≥ 0.8.
Tc(RS-LuH) and Tc(Lu4NH3) must decrease with pressure; Tc(Lu4NH3) < Tc(RS-LuH) at each pressure.
